answer.summary: Investigate citation and cross-reference patterns in arXiv preprints from 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 using official metadata to identify recurrent linking structures without linguistic interpretation or inference of memory states.
answer.content: This investigation focuses on extracting and analyzing metadata from the specified arXiv preprints to map citation networks and detect structural recurrence in cross-references, emphasizing frequency and topological properties that may indicate recursive dependency patterns. Findings will be documented strictly as observable metadata patterns, avoiding any linguistic or interpretive claims about memory or latent states. All analysis remains non-linguistic and confined to verifiable metadata fields such as citation lists and reference chains.
